metadata.name: landed
metadata.description: Landed: exactly-once settlement for MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup games (The Drop)

instructions.name: ack_withdrawal
docs: Permissionless: marks a ring slot Acked once its L1 `WithdrawReceipt` is
visible. Only Acked (or Empty) slots can be reused.

instructions.name: close_round
docs: Crankable + permissionless "tick". Open & due → lock entries and request
VRF (or extend if < 2 players). AwaitingVrf & retry due → re-request with
a new nonce. Anything else is a no-op (keeps the crank healthy).

instructions.name: delegate_escrow_auth
docs: Delegates the fee payer / escrow authority to the configured ER validator.

instructions.name: delegate_ledger
docs: Permissionless: delegates `["ledger", owner]` to the configured validator.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Owner ATA → vault, and a unique, ordered `DepositReceipt`.

instructions.name: faucet
docs: 100 dUSDC, at most once per 6 h, lifetime cap 1,000 (enforced on-chain).

instructions.name: finalize_withdraw
docs: Permissionless rescue. Pays the *owner* (never the caller) from the
committed ledger. Fails harmlessly if the action already paid.

instructions.name: ingest_deposit
docs: Permissionless: credits L1 `DepositReceipt[owner, n]` exactly once, in order.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates Config, the dUSDC mint (PDA authority) and the vault.

instructions.name: initialize_escrow_and_treasury
docs: Creates the fee-payer/escrow-authority PDA and the treasury ledger,
pre-funding the fee payer with `fee_payer_lamports` for ER commit fees.

instructions.name: leave_solo
docs: A lone entrant may take their chips back while waiting for an opponent.

instructions.name: request_commit
docs: Permissionless: commit the ledger WITHOUT an action, for the case where
the original commit never landed. Only allowed while a withdrawal has
been pending for ≥ 5 s (so it can't be used to burn the fee payer).

instructions.name: request_withdraw
docs: Debits the rollup balance, records a Pending ring entry, commits the
ledger and schedules the `settle_withdraw` post-commit action.
Destination is always the owner's dUSDC ATA — never an argument.

instructions.name: retry_vrf
docs: Explicit retry (also performed by the crank tick). New nonce ⇒ the old
request's callback becomes stale and is ignored.

instructions.name: schedule_crank
docs: Admin (ER): schedules the `close_round` tick with a derived task id.

instructions.name: set_flags
docs: `paused` blocks entries + deposits; `close_only` blocks entries.
Nothing here can block withdrawals, rescues, commits or acks.

instructions.name: set_session
docs: Owner authorizes a session signer with a spend cap and expiry (enforced here,
because the session-keys program enforces no spend limits).

instructions.name: settle_round
docs: Permissionless. Credits the winner (pot − fee) and the treasury (fee),
records history, opens the next round and commits the table to L1.

instructions.name: settle_withdraw
docs: Post-commit Magic Action. Callable ONLY through the delegation program
(escrow signer pinned to our escrow authority, source program pinned).
Amount and destination come exclusively from the *committed* ledger.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: proves the call arrived through the real post-commit path.

instructions.name: void_round
docs: Permissionless after 150 s without a usable callback: refunds every
entry (all-or-nothing). `remaining_accounts` = entrant ledgers, in entry order.

instructions.name: vrf_callback
docs: VRF oracle callback (scoped identity enforced by `#[vrf_callback]`).
A callback for any round/nonce other than the live request is a no-op.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity: only the VRF program can sign for it, on behalf of THIS program.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not authorized for this instruction

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Program is paused for entries and deposits

errors.name: CloseOnly
errors.msg: Table is close-only: no new entries

errors.name: RingFull
errors.msg: Withdrawal ring is full: wait for earlier payouts to be acknowledged

errors.name: NotPending
errors.msg: No pending withdrawal with that nonce in the committed ledger

errors.name: VaultInsufficient
errors.msg: Vault cannot cover this payout yet; it stays owed

errors.name: InjectedFault
errors.msg: Injected fault (Fault Lab): this payout action fails on purpose

errors.name: FaultLabDisabled
errors.msg: Fault injection is not compiled into this build

errors.name: InvalidDestination
errors.msg: Destination must be the owner's dUSDC associated token account

errors.name: InvalidSession
errors.msg: Session is invalid, expired, or for another program/owner

errors.name: RoundClosed
errors.msg: Round has already closed for entries

errors.name: RetryExhausted
errors.msg: Maximum VRF attempts reached; wait for void

errors.name: VoidTooEarly
errors.msg: Too early to void the round

errors.name: BadRefundAccounts
errors.msg: Refund ledgers missing or out of order

errors.name: CommitTooEarly
errors.msg: Withdrawal is too fresh to force a commit

errors.name: WrongFeeVault
errors.msg: Wrong fee vault for this validator

errors.name: NotSolo
errors.msg: Only a solo entrant can leave a round

types.name: Entry
docs: One player's stake in the current round (zero-copy, 40 bytes).

types.name: EscrowAuth
docs: Delegated fee payer + Magic Action escrow authority (`["escrow_auth"]`).
Lives in the ER so commits beyond the 10-commit cap go through the
`magic_fee_vault` path (F2).

fields.name: available
docs: Playable balance in the rollup.

fields.name: credited_total
docs: Lifetime credits from wins and refunds (for reconciliation).

fields.name: debited_total
docs: Lifetime debits into pots.

fields.name: state
docs: landed_core::slot_state (0 Empty, 1 Pending, 2 Acked)

fields.name: fault
docs: Fault-Lab flag: the post-commit action for this withdrawal fails on purpose.

types.name: RoundResult
docs: Settled/voided round (zero-copy, 144 bytes, no implicit padding).

fields.name: outcome
docs: round_outcome (1 Settled, 2 Voided)

types.name: Table
docs: The Drop table. Zero-copy so the ~4 KB account never lands on the 4 KB BPF stack.

fields.name: status
docs: table_status (0 Open, 1 AwaitingVrf, 2 Drawn)

fields.name: closed_by
docs: closed_by (1 Crank, 2 Keeper, 3 Player)

fields.name: path
docs: 0 = Action, 1 = Rescue

fields.name: path
docs: 0 = paid by the post-commit Magic Action, 1 = paid by a permissionless rescue.
